text:
sara-support: Hey team, urgent customer ticket — SCIM provisioning started failing after an IdP attribute rename. They updated the SAML assertion to change `member_of` -> `groups_v2` and now some users are getting created without roles and we’re not seeing corresponding audit entries. Customer reported failed org actions and billing attribution is off. Can someone triage? :exclamation:

nate-eng: Can you paste the repro steps and a trace id? Which endpoint is returning the error (provisioning API vs audit export)?

sara-support: Repro steps from the tenant: 1) IdP sends SAML with new claim `groups_v2` 2) SCIM sync runs (auto) 3) Many users show `role: null` in the tenant UI. 4) When we try to list audit logs for the same time range, there are gaps. Trace/req: `req_0a1b2c3d4e` Customer timestamp: 2026-02-27T15:12:21Z.

nate-eng: Thanks. Can you drop the sync worker logs around that req id? Also ping the KMS team if there are any decrypt errors — missing audit writes + missing role assignment smells like a KMS key fail when writing encrypted attributes.

sara-support: Paste from sync-worker.log (redacted):

```
2026-02-27T15:12:20.842Z INFO sync-worker request=req_0a1b2c3d4e start sync for tenant=acme-corp
2026-02-27T15:12:21.011Z WARN sync-worker request=req_0a1b2c3d4e scim: attribute mapping missing for claim=groups_v2
2026-02-27T15:12:21.117Z ERROR sync-worker request=req_0a1b2c3d4e role-resolver: failed to encrypt role assignment: kms.DecryptError: rpc error: code = Aborted desc = HSM: decrypt timeout
2026-02-27T15:12:21.119Z ERROR sync-worker request=req_0a1b2c3d4e audit: write failed: 503 Service Unavailable (write-audit)
2026-02-27T15:12:21.120Z INFO sync-worker request=req_0a1b2c3d4e completed with failures (roles_missing=42)
```

nate-eng: OK that KMS/HSM decrypt timeout is the smoking gun. Which KMS key is that tenant using? Is this a per-tenant key in the HSM or our platform-managed key?

sara-support: Customer is on customer-managed key (BYOK) in HSM cluster `hsm-1-eu`. They rotated it last week — they say rotation completed. Tenant config: `kms_key_id: projects/acme/keys/rw-prod-tenant`

olivia-sec: Two asks: 1) We need to confirm whether unencrypted role metadata was ever persisted anywhere during the failed writes (PII/exposure). 2) Export the audit window (15:12:00–15:15:00) from write-audit and the local sync-worker buffer so we can compare missing entries. If HSM returned timeouts, writes may have been retried and dropped. Also raise an incident if any retention policy gaps appear.

kevin-sre: I'm on it. Quick check shows `hsm-1-eu` had intermittent RPC timeouts at 15:11–15:13 — paging graph: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hsm/hsm-1-eu?from=167/.. (short link). SCIM worker pod `sync-42b` restarted at 15:14 (deploy-bot shows restart). I'll run a replay for that tenant against the sync-worker in read-only mode to rehydrate roles, and attempt a safe audit write to a quarantined bucket.

kevin-sre: Replay command I ran (for internal runbook):

```
# replay sync in dry-run; does not write audit by default
./tools/scim-sync --tenant acme-corp --from 2026-02-27T15:10:00Z --to 2026-02-27T15:20:00Z --dry-run --trace req_0a1b2c3d4e
```

kevin-sre: Dry-run shows correct role resolutions when talking to KMS via fallback key `platform-fallback-key` (used for degraded mode) but when we switch to the tenant key the HSM calls timeout. Suggestion: temporarily enable fallback key for that tenant to allow role writes and backfill audit entries, then rotate their key again with coordination.

olivia-sec: Fallback key will reduce isolation guarantees — need customer sign-off. Also we must record the key-switch in the audit trail (show who approved) and ensure any rollback is possible. Requesting approval from legal/compliance before toggling.

sara-support: Asked customer for approval (they're online). Quick question: is there any chance the missing audit rows will affect billing calc for that window? They saw a $0.03 delta but want the correct attribution.

nate-eng: Billing attribution reads from both audit logs and usage counters. If audit rows are missing but usage counters remain, we can reconcile. We'll run a reconciliation job once we rehydrate audit entries. If rehydration not possible, we'll create synthetic audit entries flagged as "rehydrated" and reference the KMS incident.

deploy-bot: scim-sync-worker/sync-42b restarted at 2026-02-27T15:14:32 by k8s (OOMKill=false) — image: redwood/scim-sync:v3.6.5

kevin-sre: Plan of action: (1) Export audit window -> storage/quarantine/acme/15-12-15-15 (2) Request customer sig for fallback-key write -> awaiting (3) If approved, enable fallback key and run backfill tool: `./tools/audit-backfill --tenant acme-corp --trace req_0a1b2c3d4e --source dryrun-output.json` (4) Run billing reconcile and mark any synthetic entries with `meta.rehydrated:true` (5) Postmortem with KMS team to fix HSM timeouts.

olivia-sec: Add me + legal + compliance to the approval thread. Also set retention hold on the quarantine export until the PM/Legal sign-off.

sara-support: Customer approved fallback key use for immediate fix (they're ok with temporary reduced isolation). They're asking for ETA.

kevin-sre: ETA: export + enable fallback + backfill should be ~90 minutes. I'll start the export now and update. Assigning owner: `kevin-sre` for execution, `olivia-sec` for compliance sign-off, `nate-eng` for backfill validation.

sara-support: Thanks — I'll update the customer and keep this thread as the coordination hub. :thumbsup:

kevin-sre: exported audit files to `s3://quarantine-exports/acme/1972103333/` and toggled fallback key flag for tenant in staging. Starting backfill run now.

sara-support: Noted, customer acknowledged ETA and will monitor billing.

nate-eng: Backfill ran; 42 role assignments rehydrated, audit rows written with `meta.rehydrated=true`, billing reconcile queued (job id `bill_recon_789`). Closing loop after reconcile completes.

olivia-sec: Please keep retention hold on quarantine export until postmortem completes. I'll schedule the postmortem with KMS/HSM leads.

sara-support: Closing ticket once billing reconcile confirms numbers. Will file follow-up for least-privilege review of the fallback key procedure.

kevin-sre: Postmortem draft: suspected root cause = intermittent HSM RPC timeouts after key rotation; remediation = improve HSM client retry/backoff + stricter health checks, and require rotation drills.

sara-support: Thanks everyone, marking as in-progress and assigning owners in ticketing system.
